title: Mutual Futures
summary: Explore how retiring business owners, workers and communities could build shared ownership, reliable livelihoods and more time for life.
opportunity: Develop a succession brief for one willing business, including its customers, finances, leadership roles and ownership options.
evidenceNote: A public planning workbench, not an operating acquisition fund or investment offer.

title: Virtual Solar Swarm
summary: Design a possible network of satellites using interactive orbit, sensor, launch and communications tools.
opportunity: Choose one observation problem, compare a small mission with existing data services, then define the next engineering test.
evidenceNote: Teaching models and adjustable cost targets. No satellites have been built or launched by this project.

title: Grain by Grain
summary: A documentary concept connects everyday life with long-term resilience, existential threats and a seven-generation civilisation story.
opportunity: Develop a source-backed short film or research sequence with a clear audience, production budget and next screening.
evidenceNote: A proposed 90-minute documentary. Its larger infrastructure visions are not completed projects.

title: GAJRA Earth
summary: An invitation to help define what intelligent systems should make possible: lives that are joyful, responsible and abundant.
opportunity: Host a small listening session and turn one shared aspiration into a practical project brief.
evidenceNote: A separate July 2026 interpretation of the GAJRA concept. It does not establish a registered global association.

title: Brisbane Peaceful Space & Civic AI Summit
summary: A proposed gathering connects peaceful space, civic AI, care, public evidence and creative participation.
opportunity: Shape one working session around a useful outcome, then identify the people, venue needs and delivery costs.
evidenceNote: Programme, dates, speakers, venue and backing remain to be confirmed.

title: GAJRA Earth Infinity
summary: A public practice for listening, choosing useful actions, examining results and improving what comes next.
opportunity: Run a meeting circle around a local need and publish an agreed action, a result to examine and the next revision.
evidenceNote: A concept and participation framework. Historical event and organisational plans are not current commitments.

title: Future of Life 2045
summary: Explore possible futures for relationships, living systems, intelligence, movement, science and culture.
opportunity: Choose one desirable feature of future life and work backwards to a small service or experiment that could be tested now.
evidenceNote: Authored future scenarios sit alongside public projects; the 2045 world is a vision, not a forecast.

title: Oceania Healthy De-Slop Co-ops
summary: Explore community-shaped cooperative spaces for wellbeing, reflection, shared equipment and locally controlled computing.
opportunity: Ask a local group which shared service would be useful, then compare access, running costs and suitable operating arrangements.
evidenceNote: Not a registered cooperative or operating clinic. Health and equipment claims need their own evidence and review.

title: Minjerribah Site and Service Ideas
summary: A public workbench connects ideas for housing, ageing, shared spaces, making, culture and community wealth.
opportunity: Develop one service brief with the people it would support, including demand, staffing, access and realistic costs.
evidenceNote: The workbench does not establish property rights, site access, an operating organisation or agreed partnerships.

title: Ready S.E.T. Cultural Intelligence Node
summary: Explore shared local computing alongside sustainable employment, training, media, making and cultural collaboration.
opportunity: Cost one real workload and compare a shared local service with purchased computing, including power, support and training.
evidenceNote: The proposed Dunwich rack is a reference design. Equipment installation, cooperative formation and cultural permissions are not assumed.

title: Extreme Matter Atlas
summary: Explore elements, crystals, metamaterials and frontier ideas through quantities, mechanisms and the nearest working technology.
opportunity: Write a material test brief: target property, possible sample, required measurement, laboratory access and cost.
evidenceNote: Measured results, predictions and speculative ideas need to remain distinct; atlas inclusion is not validation.

title: Straddie Clean Energy Superpower
summary: Compare island energy possibilities, from rooftop solar and storage to heat, water and emerging research.
opportunity: Define one local energy need, measure demand and compare practical supply or storage options.
evidenceNote: A question-led options atlas, not an approved energy project or completed engineering design.

title: Straddie Tip Loop Lab
summary: Explore how repair, reuse and local material recovery could keep more value on the island.
opportunity: Trace one material stream from source to a possible customer, including quality, processing cost and lawful handling.
evidenceNote: No waste-operation authority, council endorsement, facility or funding commitment is claimed.

title: Straddie Maker-Space Lab
summary: A proposed Dunwich maker-space connects useful production, repair, shared tools and practical learning.
opportunity: Choose one repair or making service and test demand, tool requirements, skills, pricing and a suitable space.
evidenceNote: A public concept for a future facility, not an established workshop or confirmed site.

title: Moreton Bay Autonomous Mobility
summary: Explore passenger and delivery services that could include existing operators in local ownership, work and profit.
opportunity: Map one underserved journey with passengers and operators, then define access needs, operating costs and the decisions required.
evidenceNote: No route, vehicle supplier, permit, partner or government programme is confirmed by this proposal.

title: Minjerribah Screen & Media Network
summary: Connect local stories, screen work, learning and trusted information through a staged community media proposal.
opportunity: Build a small production brief with a willing client or community group, including paid roles, permissions and an audience.
evidenceNote: An invitation connecting public projects, not an official network, confirmed partnership or accredited training provider.

title: Straddie Market Onboarding
summary: A public toolkit helps stallholders, artists, food providers, venues and organisers prepare useful market information.
opportunity: Test a simple market service with an organiser, covering stall needs, visitor access, operating costs and follow-up.
evidenceNote: Existing organisers set the terms. A public toolkit does not announce a new market or confirm a stall.

title: Minjerribah Living Twin
summary: A browser simulation explores connections between island ecology, services, movement and everyday life.
opportunity: Choose one planning question and compare a small model with reliable public records and observed conditions.
evidenceNote: An unfinished public-records prototype, not a validated planning model. It has not been reviewed by Traditional Owners.
